crossRefs.note: Abigail hurried, and arose, and rode on a donkey, with five ladies of hers who followed her; and she went after the…
David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.

people.name: Abigail
people.line: Wife of Nabal, later married David

people.name: Ahinoam
people.line: Wife of David, from Jezreel; mother of Amnon

people.name: Carmel
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A town in Judah, home of David's wife Ahinoam

people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
translations.bsb: So David went there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
translations.kjv: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.
translations.asv: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
